title: SIDESTORY: BABEL OPEN
lines: DETAILS: Babel event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing the event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 3 phases:
- Phase 1 "You the Future, Take My Gifts"
- Phase 2 "You the Past, Ward Me Firmly"
- Phase 3 "You the Constant, You Are Me"
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [The King's Calls to Arms] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Odda], 'Scar Market Memories' (Pieces), Module Materials, Raw Sugar Lumps, etc.

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Raw Sugar Lumps by clearing event stages and completing [The King's Calls to Arms] missions. Raw Sugar Lumps can be used to redeem items from [Motorized Logistical Camp].
REWARDS: Odda's token, 'Scar Market Memories' (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Test Collection Series - Newsgirl for Amiya, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, Furniture Part, etc.
-During this event, the event stories cannot be reviewed in [Public Affairs]. After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
-After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Intermezzi].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – LIKE ENDING LIKE DEATH
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Like Ending Like Death], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
The following Operators will be added to the game:
- Operator Odda is currently ONLY available to be obtained from event Babel, and is NOT available in any [Standard Headhunting] or [Kernel Headhunting].
- Ascalon, Aroma, and Lutonada will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after October 24, 2024, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Ascalon, Aroma, Odda and Lutonada will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.

CONTENTS: Specialist Dualchip * 4, Specialist Chip * 5, Skill Summary - 3 * 45, Skill Summary - 2 * 25, Skill Summary - 1 * 10
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
CONTENT: Like Ending Like Death Headhunting Permit * 2
CONTENT: Like Ending Like Death Ten-roll Headhunting Permit * 1

- Like Ending Like Death Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform one roll in [Like Ending Like Death]. Like Ending Like Death Ten-roll Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Like Ending Like Death].
- Like Ending Like Death Headhunting Permit & Like Ending Like Death Ten-roll Headhunting Permit expire on: October 24, 2024, 03:59 (UTC-7).
